annotations.title: Add a note to a review

description: Append a free-standing text note (not tied to a screenshot) to a review created by create_review. Use for context, steps taken, or a summary of findings between screenshots.

claim_token.description: The claim_token from create_review (authorizes the write). For a review the human has SAVED to their account, pass the agent token they generated on the review page (Export & more → Hand to your agent) here instead.

review.description: The review slug or URL from create_review.

text.description: The note text (plain text or markdown).

name: add_note
